name: Internalize the principle; purge inherited diction
decision_structure: A writer wants to learn from strong models without producing derivative prose. The transferable value of prior writing lies in its governing intent, judgment or structural principle, while copied or stale diction can make the output look familiar without becoming the writer's own.
rule: Study strong models deeply enough to recover what governs their choices, but do not transfer their surface wording by default. During revision, actively identify stale, borrowed or template-like formulations and replace them with language generated by the present claim, audience and context.
operational_actions: For each admired reference, write down the underlying move before borrowing any phrase: e.g. contrast, definition, escalation, evidence order, audience move.
Remove the reference text and rewrite the passage from the current article's own facts and claim.
Flag phrases that could appear unchanged in many unrelated essays; treat familiarity as a revision signal, not as proof of quality.
Preserve target-platform register; do not imitate Classical Chinese diction to activate this lens.
After rewriting, check whether the borrowed structure still serves the current article rather than the prestige of the model.
boundary_conditions: This is not a ban on quotation, technical terminology or necessary conventional phrasing.
The source model must first be understood; superficial paraphrase is not principle-level learning.
Originality does not override clarity, factual precision or genre conventions.
Modern platform writing may intentionally use familiar formulas for navigation; the lens should target unnecessary template language, not every convention.
failure_signals: The revised article sounds like the admired writer rather than the present author.
A phrase is retained mainly because it sounds literary or authoritative.
The article swaps one set of clichés for another set of fashionable anti-cliché expressions.
The writer cannot explain what underlying decision was learned from the model.

specificity.generic_baseline_overlap: medium: originality and anti-cliche advice are generic, but Han Yu's paired operation—deeply model prior writing while explicitly refusing its diction—is more specific.
specificity.writer_added_delta: The added delta is the tension-resolving sequence: learn exemplary predecessors at the level of governing intent, then deliberately remove inherited phrasing rather than choosing between imitation and originality as opposites.

composition_audit.alternative_interpretation: The letters concern classical prose and moral-literary formation; WriteMind transfers only the anti-derivative decision structure to modern writing.
